arxiv-1605-09523.title: On Equivalence of Matrices footnoteinfo
arxiv-1605-09523.creator: Daizhan Cheng
arxiv-1605-09523.description: Abstract A new matrix product, called the semi-tensor product (STP), is briefly reviewed. The STP extends the classical matrix product to two arbitrary matrices. Under STP the set of matrices becomes a monoid (semi-group with identity). Some related structures and properties are investigated.

arxiv-2005-11433.title: Implementing Non-Equilibrium Networks with Active Circuits of Duplex Catalysts
arxiv-2005-11433.creator: Antti Lankinen, Ismael Mullor Ruiz, Thomas E. Ouldridge
arxiv-2005-11433.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Antti Lankinen, Ismael Mullor Ruiz, Thomas E. Ouldridge. DNA strand displacement (DSD) reactions have been used to construct chemical reaction networks in which species act catalytically at the level of the overall stoichiometry of reactions. These effective catalytic reactions are typically realised through one or more of the following: many-stranded gate complexes to coordinate the catalysis, indirect interaction between the catalyst and its substrate, and the recovery of a distinct “catalyst” strand from the one that triggered the reaction.

arxiv-2409-11411.creator: Mubashir ul Islam, Humza Sami, Pierre-Emmanuel Gaillardon, Valerio Tenace
arxiv-2409-11411.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) are computational models capable of performing complex natural language processing tasks. Leveraging these capabilities, LLMs hold the potential to transform the entire hardware design stack, with predictions suggesting that front-end and back-end tasks could be fully automated in the near future.

arxiv-2505-09587.title: On-surface Synthesis of a Ferromagnetic Molecular Spin Trimer
arxiv-2505-09587.creator: Alessio Vegliante, Manuel Vilas-Varela, Ricardo Ortiz, Francisco Romero Lara, Manish Kumar, Lucía Gómez-Rodrigo, Fabian Schulz, Diego Soler, Hassan Ahmoum, Emilio Artacho, Thomas Frederiksen, Pavel Jelínek, Jose Ignacio Pascual, Diego Peña
arxiv-2505-09587.description: Abstract Triangulenes are prototypical examples of open-shell nanographenes. Their magnetic properties, arising from the presence of unpaired π \pi electrons, can be extensively tuned by modifying their size and shape or by introducing heteroatoms. Different triangulene derivatives have been designed and synthesized in recent years, thanks to the development of on-surface synthesis strategies.

arxiv-2506-12377.title: Impact of in-plane disorders on the thermal conductivity of AgCrSe 2
arxiv-2506-12377.creator: Shota Izumi, Yui Ishii, Jinfeng Zhu, Tsunemasa Sakamoto, Shintaro Kobayashi, Shogo Kawaguchi, Jie Ma, Shigeo Mori
arxiv-2506-12377.description: Abstract Superionic conductors have recently attracted renewed attention for their use as thermoelectric materials due to their extremely low lattice thermal conductivity. Of central interest is why the superionic conductors exhibit such low thermal conductivity, and competing mechanisms have been proposed thus far.

arxiv-2512-05983.title: AI-Generated Compromises for Coalition Formation: Modeling, Simulation, and a Textual Case Study
arxiv-2512-05983.creator: Eyal Briman, Ehud Shapiro, Nimrod Talmon
arxiv-2512-05983.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Eyal Briman, Ehud Shapiro, Nimrod Talmon. The challenge of finding compromises between agent proposals is fundamental to AI sub-fields such as argumentation [ 28 ] , mediation [ 23 ] , and negotiation [ 21 ] . Building on this tradition, Elkind et al. [ 10 ] introduced a process for coalition formation that seeks majority-supported proposals preferable to the status quo, using a metric space where each agent has an ideal point.

pmc-10642016.title: Educational technology on tuberculosis: construction shared with Primary Health Care nurses
pmc-10642016.creator: Aloma Sena Soares, Laura Maria Vidal Nogueira, Erlon Gabriel Rego de Andrade, Élida Fernanda Rêgo de Andrade, Ivaneide Leal Ataíde Rodrigues
pmc-10642016.description: Objective:to develop, in a participatory way, an educational technology to assist nurses in the management of tuberculosis cases in Primary Health Care.Methods:methodological research with a qualitative approach. Data were collected between June and October 2022, in 25 Basic Health Units, with 41 nurses interviewed individually. Thematic content analysis was carried out to guide technology elaboration.

pmc-10735619.title: REAL-TIME HEALTH OUTCOMES AMONG OLDER ADULTS INITIATING MEDICAL CANNABIS FOR CHRONIC PAIN
pmc-10735619.creator: Yan Wang, Kimberly Sibille, Zhigang Li, Rene Przkora, Seigfried Schmidt, Margaret Lo, Ana Abrantes, Robert Cook
pmc-10735619.description: Background: Rigorous data are needed on the short- and long-term effects of medical cannabis (MC) on older adults with chronic pain. In response, this prospective study combines technology-based ecological momentary assessments (EMA) and in-person visits over 12 months to obtain subjective and objective data on MC’s effects on older adults.

pmc-11390880.title: Logistic regression analysis and machine learning for predicting post-stroke gait independence: a retrospective study
pmc-11390880.creator: Yuta Miyazaki, Michiyuki Kawakami, Kunitsugu Kondo, Akiko Hirabe, Takayuki Kamimoto, Tomonori Akimoto, Nanako Hijikata, Masahiro Tsujikawa, Kaoru Honaga, Kanjiro Suzuki, Tetsuya Tsuji
pmc-11390880.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). This study investigated whether machine learning (ML) has better predictive accuracy than logistic regression analysis (LR) for gait independence at discharge in subacute stroke patients (n = 843) who could not walk independently at admission. We developed prediction models using LR and five ML algorithms—specifically, the decision tree (DT), support vector machine, artificial neural network, ensemble learning, and k-nearest neighbor methods. Functional Independence Measure sub-items were used to evaluate the ability to walk independently.

pmc-11489762.title: Controllable mechanism of hazardous jarosite transformation into recyclable hematite in the leaching solution of secondary zinc oxide powder
pmc-11489762.creator: Yubo Xing, Chang Wei, Zhigan Deng, Xingbin Li, Minting Li
pmc-11489762.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The controlled synthesis of recyclable hematite in the leaching solution of secondary zinc oxide powder is an urgent problem in the chemical industry and metallurgy fields. In this paper, the effects of the temperature, agitation speed, and seed addition on the contents of iron, sulfur, potassium, sodium, and zinc in the iron removal residues, as well as the iron concentration in the supernatant after iron removal were systematically studied.

pmc-12471168.title: GmSAUR46b Integrates Light Signals to Regulate Leaf Midrib Thickness and Stem Trichome Density in Soybean
pmc-12471168.creator: Xiao Li, Bei Liu, Yunhua Yang, Han Gou, Huan Du, Yuhao Chen, Huakun Yu, Jinming Zhao, Fengjie Yuan, Kwon-Kyoo Kang
pmc-12471168.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Soybean (Glycine max (L.) Merr.) is a vital crop for the global supply of protein and oil, with its growth and development being regulated by genetic, hormonal, and environmental factors, particularly light and hormone signaling. The Small Auxin-Up RNA (SAUR) gene family plays a crucial role in plant growth regulation; however, the molecular mechanisms by which GmSAUR46 integrates photosynthesis and hormonal networks in soybean remain unclear.

pmc-12538991.title: Association between anxiety disorders and medication adherence in patients with cardiovascular disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis of observational studies
pmc-12538991.creator: Tingting Wang, Zhiyong Li, Yunjie Wei, Xiaofei Zhang, Qianjiao Yuan, Xiaohong Zhang, Xuying Li, Qinqin Lei
pmc-12538991.description: BackgroundThe management of cardiovascular (CV) diseases is considerably hindered by the presence of anxiety disorders, which act as a significant barrier to medication adherence. This systematic review and meta-analysis aim to synthesize existing evidence on the relationship between anxiety and medication adherence in individuals with CV diseases.MethodsA systematic search was conducted across five major databases from inception to 2025.

pmc-12550052.title: Analysis of factors influencing polycystic ovary syndrome in women of reproductive age based on directed acyclic graphs
pmc-12550052.creator: Huixi Yu, Yu Guo, Yingni Ling, Yinhua Su, Zhongyu Li
pmc-12550052.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) is a common gynecological endocrine disorder in women of reproductive age that seriously affects both their physical and mental health. The pathogenesis of PCOS is complex and not yet fully understood, and it is crucial to control for bias and analyze the risk factors for its development in order to provide a basis for developing preventive strategies. A case–control study design was used.

pmc-12786794.title: Comparison of Different Surgical Techniques for Osia® System Implantation—Experience from Two European Clinical Centers
pmc-12786794.creator: Wojciech Gawęcki, Ann-Kathrin Rauch, Marta Pietraszek, Maria Jaworska, Susan Arndt
pmc-12786794.description: Background/Objectives: This study aimed to compare two surgical techniques for Osia® system implantation performed at two European clinical centers: Poznań (Poland) and Freiburg (Germany). Methods: The study included 83 patients who underwent Osia® OSI200 and OSI300 implantation (89 implants). The analysis focused on surgical technique, postoperative healing, and long-term skin integrity and aesthetic outcomes.

pmc-12829248.title: Factors associated with unsuppressed HIV viral load among children under 15 years in sub-Saharan africa: a systematic review
pmc-12829248.creator: Jacques Kanku Balowe, Ngoma Mayindu Alain, Aimée Lulebo Mampasi, Mutombo Beya Wa Bitadi Paulin
pmc-12829248.description: BackgroundViral suppression among children living with HIV remains suboptimal in sub-Saharan Africa. The marked heterogeneity in suppression rates across countries underscores the need for comparative analyses to elucidate context-specific determinants. This systematic review aims to synthesize existing evidence on factors associated with unsuppressed viral loads in paediatric populations.

pmc-13362810.title: Timing of Endoscopic Biliary Drainage for Acute Cholangitis Associated with Common Bile Duct Stones in Elderly Patients: A Single-Center Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-13362810.creator: Hironao Ichikawa, Akinori Maruta, Kaori Koide, Hiroki Taniguchi, Susumu Imai, Tomomichi Matsushita, Junko Shiroko, Takuji Iwashita, Masahito Shimizu
pmc-13362810.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background/Objectives: The optimal timing for biliary drainage in elderly patients remains controversial. This study compared the clinical outcomes of early versus late biliary drainage in elderly patients diagnosed with acute cholangitis associated with common bile duct stones (CBDS). Methods: This single-center, retrospective cohort study compared early (within 24 h of admission) versus late (>24 h after admission) biliary drainage using endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP) in 143 elderly patients diagnosed with acute cholangitis, who were divided into early and late groups, respectively.

pmc-13370750.title: Frontoparietal control-default mode connectivity predicts TMS effects on cognitive control
pmc-13370750.creator: Brian Kim, John D. Medaglia
pmc-13370750.description: Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (TMS) is a promising tool to probe and enhance cognitive control, yet effects are often inconsistent across individuals. These inconsistencies may arise from individual differences in Lateral Frontoparietal (Control) Network (L-FPN) and Medial Frontoparietal (Default) Network (M-FPN) interactions, essential for suppressing internal distraction and facilitating cognitive control.

pmc-13411941.title: Joint optimization for throughput fairness maximization in laser-powered UAV communications
pmc-13411941.creator: Guolong Zhang, Qian Dan, Yutian Zhang
pmc-13411941.description: This paper investigates a laser-powered UAV communication system. To maximize the minimum throughput among ground nodes, we jointly optimize communication scheduling, transmit power, and UAV trajectory. The resulting non-convex problem is decomposed into three subproblems and solved via successive convex approximation and iterative techniques. The simulation results show that our algorithm has fast and stable convergence.

pmc-13529628.title: The influence of functional groups and their relative position on isotopic exchange between 19F and 18F in aromatic rings
pmc-13529628.creator: Antonia A Högnäsbacka, Miguel A Cortés González, Afrizki D Wiranegara, Magnus Schou
pmc-13529628.description: BackgroundIsotopic exchange with fluorine-18 offers a conceptually simple approach to positron emission tomography (PET) tracer development, as the target compound itself serves as the labeling precursor.ResultsIn this study, we investigated the influence of functional groups and substituent position on the efficiency of isotopic exchange with fluorine-18.

pmc-13554923.title: JAK2 Variant and Parkinsonian Syndromes: Coincidence or Pathophysiological Link?
pmc-13554923.creator: Elena Ardila Jurado, Koustubh Bavdhankar, Divyani Garg, Francesca Magrinelli, Huw R Morris, Kailash P Bhatia
pmc-13554923.description: Background JAK2 variants are a hallmark of myeloproliferative neoplasms (MPNs), including polycythemia vera and essential thrombocythemia. These disorders are often associated with thrombotic and inflammatory complications. From a movement disorder perspective, chorea is a rare but well‐recognized neurological occurrence in this context, whereas parkinsonism has received limited attention.

pmc-13557889.title: Perioperative safety and risk stratification of simultaneous resection for multiple pulmonary nodules via video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-13557889.creator: Jiantong Sun, Zhenyu Yang, Yin Ku, Jie Cao, Jixuan Zheng, Shiyou Wei, Lunxu Liu
pmc-13557889.description: BackgroundThe detection of multiple pulmonary nodules (MPNs) has increased significantly, yet evidence regarding the safety of simultaneous resection using video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery (VATS) remains limited. This study evaluated treatment-requiring postoperative pulmonary complications (PPCs) and procedure-specific risk factors after VATS-based simultaneous resection for MPNs, with particular attention to combined anatomical resections and segmentectomy-related anatomy.

pmc-13700230.title: Predicting blastocyst viability: the role of post-vitrification re-expansion speed and its correlation with artificial collapse and preimplantation genetic testing
pmc-13700230.creator: Adva Aizer, Shay Kaplan, Meirav Noach-Hirsh, Olga Dratviman-Storobinsky, Roni Hoshen, Aliza Segev-Zahav, Jigal Haas, Raoul Orvieto
pmc-13700230.description: BackgroundPost-thaw blastocyst behavior is clinically relevant and closely linked to implantation and pregnancy success after frozen embryo transfer. Re-expansion of the blastocyst after warming is recognized as an important indicator of embryo viability and has been associated with clinical outcomes, although it is not routinely evaluated in a dynamic manner.
